sample_tweets.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Root Access to Peruvian Debt Collection Platform  A darkweb forum post alleges that a threat actor has compromised a major debt collection and robocalling infrastructure provider based in Peru, granting them root-level access to production servers. According to the listing on the underground forum, the attacker escalated privileges via an unauthenticated webshell on two production servers (web/DB and panel/IVR) and gained SSH root access with stable, passwordless keys on the panel/IVR tier. The post claims that no EDR or antivirus solutions were detected on the affected systems, allowing for log cleaning and persistent access that survives reboots.  The actor asserts control over critical telephony functions, including the ability to originate calls through carrier trunks, spoof caller IDs, intercept live call audio, and capture voicebot speech. They also claim full read/write access to the primary MySQL database, which contains extensive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) of debtors, including names, personal phone numbers, debt amounts in Peruvian soles, bank details, and dunning messages. The alleged data exposure includes:  - 82,869,625 Call Detail Record (CDR) rows spanning from 2021 to the present - 35.7 million rows of IVR campaign data containing debtor names and amounts - A full SMS campaign database with 307,000 sends - Over 400,000 call recordings (23.87 GB) matched to debtor numbers - Full source code for the dialer and voicebot systems  The post identifies several high-profile clients whose data is allegedly stored in the system, including Banco Credicoop / Beretta-Galarce (2.9 million distinct numbers), IBRLatam (2.1 million distinct numbers), Aval Peru (457,000 distinct numbers), and Banco Patagonia (266,000 distinct numbers). In total, the actor claims to have accessed data related to 5,772,322 distinct phone numbers dialed to date, with operations extending throughout Latin America. The listing offers the stolen data and access for sale, demanding payment via escrow or money mule services.  At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by the affected organizations or security researchers. The threat actor’s identity remains unknown, though the post includes a session hash and Telegram contact information, which have been omitted from this report for safety.

🚨 Threat Actor Claims Full Compromise of Italian MSP Kirey Group, Access to Banca Mediolanum  An underground forum listing alleges a full compromise of Kirey Group, an Italian managed service provider (MSP) based in Milan with approximately 1,600 employees. The post, titled "GOLDEN TICKET," claims the threat actor has achieved persistent domain administrator access via a Golden Ticket (KRBTGT) attack and has pivoted into the internal networks of several major clients. The actor is reportedly offering the stolen credentials and access for sale in exchange for Bitcoin or Monero.  According to the listing, the breach exposes critical infrastructure and data from Kirey Group and its customers. The alleged compromised assets include:  - Golden Ticket (KRBTGT) for full Kerberos domain compromise - Access to customer networks including Banca Mediolanum, Generali, Unicoop Firenze, and Unicredit via jump stations and VPN - Several gigabytes of Active Directory (AD) dumps containing all attributes - 11 EC2 private keys, including recent production keys - Working Check Point VPN access without MFA enforcement - Datacenter locations in Poland and Frankfurt (Germany)  The post includes sample evidence such as an LDAP entry for a user account and an excerpt of an EC2 key labeled "ec2-unicredit-sftp-prod." It also claims possession of M365 OAuth2 client secrets in clear text. Kirey Group serves as a critical IT infrastructure provider for numerous large financial and retail institutions in Italy, making the alleged pivot into these client networks particularly significant if verified.  At the time of reporting, neither Kirey Group nor the mentioned financial institutions have publicly confirmed the incident. The claims remain unverified, and no independent evidence has been released to corroborate the extent of the alleged compromise.  #DataBreach #KireyGroup #GoldenTicket #ItalianCyberSecurity #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

🚨 Alleged 221M Record Breach of China Railway 12306 Data Listed for Sale  A darkweb forum post claims the theft of a massive database containing personal information from China Railway 12306, the official ticketing platform for China's state railway network. The actor alleges that the dataset comprises 221.23 million user records and is currently available for purchase for $500 via cryptocurrency.  The post includes a sample of the alleged data, which appears to expose highly sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) for registered users. The exposed fields include:  - Full names and usernames - Chinese Resident Identity Card numbers - Mobile phone numbers - Dates of birth and gender - Travel history, including frequent routes and total ticket counts - Loyalty program details, such as member levels and points balances - Student status and associated educational institutions  China Railway 12306 is a critical national infrastructure component, handling ticket sales for one of the world's largest railway systems. A breach of this magnitude would represent a significant privacy incident, potentially exposing the travel habits and identity documents of hundreds of millions of citizens. If authentic, the exposure of identity card numbers and phone numbers could facilitate targeted phishing, identity fraud, and social engineering attacks against Chinese residents.  The threat actor behind the listing has not been independently identified or verified in this context. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by China Railway or security researchers.

sample_tweets.text: 🇺🇸🚨 GEORGIA POWER CUSTOMER PORTAL BREACHED — ~400,000 ACCOUNTS AFFECTED  Georgia Power has disclosed unauthorized access to its online customer portal.  The company says an unauthorized third party accessed information associated with approximately:  400,000 ACCOUNTS  including roughly:  300,000 GEORGIA POWER CUSTOMERS.  Information potentially accessed includes:  * Names * Addresses * Phone numbers * Email addresses * Last four digits of Social Security numbers  Georgia Power says the attacker did NOT gain access to:  * Bank-account information * Payment-card information * Driver's-license numbers  The utility says it detected suspicious activity involving its customer portal and took immediate action to stop the unauthorized access.  Law enforcement has been engaged.  Georgia Power says its investigation has found:  * No evidence of ongoing unauthorized access * Affected customers are being notified * Free credit monitoring is being offered  ⚠️ IMPORTANT:  The company has not publicly identified the attacker or disclosed the initial-access method.  There is currently no confirmed ransomware attribution.  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  This deserves attention because Georgia Power is not simply another online service.  It is one of the largest electric utilities in the United States, serving millions of customers and operating critical infrastructure across Georgia.  Current evidence points to compromise of the CUSTOMER PORTAL — not the electric grid or operational technology environment.  Those two things should not be conflated. 🚨 REY'S OLD OPSEC FAILURES RESURFACE AFTER HIS DETENTION IN JORDAN  Following the reported detention of suspected ShinyHunters member Saif al-Din Khader, aka “Rey,” previous investigations into how researchers identified the teenage threat actor are worth revisiting.  And his OPSEC appears to have been remarkably poor.  In 2025–2026, independent investigations by KrebsOnSecurity and IntelOps connected Rey's online identities to his real-world identity through infostealer logs, reused credentials and accounts found on a shared family computer.  IntelOps reported that an email address associated with Rey's mother:  * Reused a password linked to Rey across multiple accounts * Was connected to numerous technical/security services * Had accounts at multiple cryptocurrency exchanges  Researchers also uncovered accounts containing Rey's real name and additional links between his aliases and his family's digital footprint.  IntelOps alleged that Rey had used his mother's identity in connection with his cybercrime activity.  However, there is an important distinction:  IntelOps said it could NOT confirm whether criminal proceeds were transferred through the cryptocurrency accounts or whether his mother's identity was actually used to complete KYC at those exchanges.  That remains an allegation rather than an established fact.  The historical research has become newly relevant after Jordanian authorities detained a suspected ShinyHunters member, identified by Reuters sources as Saif al-Din Khader.  Reuters reports that Khader is now cooperating with the FBI and other international law-enforcement agencies, including helping investigators identify other alleged members.  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  Sometimes attribution doesn't require a sophisticated zero-day or intelligence operation.  Password reuse. Infostealer logs. Shared devices. Reused usernames. Personal accounts. Family-linked infrastructure.  Small OPSEC failures compound.  For threat actors, your digital footprint can eventually become the investigation.  Original IntelOps research: intelops.st/reysmom/  Krebs investigation: krebsonsecurity.com/2025/11/… #DDW #ShinyHunters #CyberCrime #OPSEC #ThreatIntelligence

🇨🇴 🚨 NUEVA EPS: 29,018 VAUPÉS RECORDS ALLEGEDLY LEAKED AFTER INSURER SAYS NO BREACH FOUND  A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have leaked 29,018 records from the Vaupés department, allegedly taken from Nueva EPS, Colombia's largest health insurer.  The listing shows: * Title: "Nueva EPS - Vaupes" * The actor describes Nueva EPS as a public-private insurer serving more than 11 million affiliates * Claimed release: "We leak 29018 records from Vaupes" * An embedded copy of Nueva EPS's public statement, which says the company activated its incident-response protocol and has not so far found evidence of unauthorized access to its systems * The actor presents the leak as a reply to that statement  The claim has not been independently verified.  ⚠️ Analyst Note: This is a follow-up to the same actor's Oct 4 claim of 11M+ Nueva EPS affiliate records with an extortion threat, and it looks like a pressure release aimed at the insurer's "no evidence of access" statement. The capture shows no field list or sample, so the scraper summary's "patient records with health data" is NOT confirmed here; only the record count and region are visible. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that Nueva EPS systems were breached. If authentic, affiliates in Vaupés, a small, largely Indigenous Amazon department, could face health-related phishing and fraud.  #DDW #DarkWeb #Colombia #NuevaEPS #Healthcare #DataLeak #Extortion #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

🇧🇪 🚨 IFAPME (BELGIUM) "FULL" DATABASE WITH ~700K RECORDS AND 85K IBANS ALLEGEDLY LEAKED  A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be leaking the "complete" dataset allegedly taken from IFAPME (ifapme[.]be), the Walloon public institute for work-study and vocational training in Belgium.  The listing shows: * Title: "[BE] IFAPME FULL" * The actor claims they logged in to an internal IFAPME platform ("ariane") with credentials found in stealer/ULP logs, then used its export function (first name, last name, birthdate, IBAN, national registry number, etc.) * A long column list that includes address, email, mobile phone, date of birth, nationality, national registry number, IBAN/BIC, disability and driving-licence fields and photo * Claimed scope: "700K information + 85K IBAN", with a 1,000-record sample offered * The actor says a first part was previously sold "to callers and spammers" and that academic records (which they say include some medical data) are being kept private  The claim has not been independently verified.  ⚠️ Analyst Note: IFAPME is a public, Wallonia-funded training body, and the claimed fields include Belgian national registry numbers and IBANs, so this would be a high-risk identity and fraud dataset if authentic. It follows a smaller IFAPME leak claim posted by a different actor on the same forum on Oct 4; this actor says that release was part of their data and calls this one the full set. The screenshot shows the column list and claimed counts, not the records themselves. The medical-data mention refers to academic records the actor says they are NOT releasing, so medical data is not part of this leak claim. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that IFAPME systems were breached. If authentic, trainees and staff could face IBAN-based payment fraud, phishing and identity misuse.  #DDW #DarkWeb #Belgium #Wallonia #IFAPME #Education #DataLeak #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

🇺🇦 🚨 UKRAINE'S LARGEST GROCERY CHAIN ATB HIT BY EXTORTION GROUP, 7.9M CUSTOMER RECORDS CLAIMED  ATB-Market, Ukraine's largest supermarket chain (1,300+ stores), is dealing with an extortion attack after a ransom note appeared on its website.  What we know:  * An extortion group calling itself DataSuckers claimed the attack and displayed a $400,000 ransom demand with a countdown timer on ATB's website, later removed * The group claims data on 7.9 million customers (names, phone numbers, emails, addresses, password hashes), employees' passport details and 11M+ order records * After ATB's statement, the group posted alleged samples on Telegram and said it will sell the database rather than leak it * ATB took some online services offline for "technical maintenance"  ATB's official statement says the temporary screen on its website "did not affect the security of your data," that the site remains fully under ATB's control and that all information is securely protected.  ⚠️ Analyst Note: The data claims are unverified and ATB denies any compromise. DataSuckers previously claimed Russian targets Dodo Pizza (which later confirmed customer data may have been accessed) and Tez Tour. ATB customers should watch for phishing and SMS scams using their order or contact details. 🇯🇵 🚨 NIKKEI DISCLOSES TWO EMPLOYEE ACCOUNT BREACHES, ~9,000 PHISHING EMAILS SENT  Japan's Nikkei Inc. (publisher of the Nikkei newspaper) disclosed two separate cyber incidents involving employees' cloud work accounts.  According to the official statements:  * A Microsoft 365 account used by a Nikkei employee was taken over and used on Sept 30 to send ~9,000 impersonation emails linking to malicious sites * Targets included staff and outside contacts, including news sources, who had corresponded with Nikkei employees * Recipients' names, email addresses and some email contents are believed to have leaked * Separately, an employee's Google Workspace account was accessed without authorization from late July, potentially exposing names and email addresses of 1,646 employees and business partners (no reader or source data, per Nikkei)  Nikkei says it changed the passwords, has seen no further unauthorized logins, and reported both incidents to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission. The scope of the Microsoft 365 leak is still under investigation.  ⚠️ Analyst Note: Nikkei warns that more emails impersonating its staff or group companies may follow. Journalists' contact lists are high-value for follow-on phishing, so treat unexpected "Nikkei" emails with links carefully. The incidents add to a wave of Japanese corporate breach disclosures in recent weeks (Daiwa Securities, Yamato Transport and others).  Official statement: nikkei.co.jp/nikkeiinfo/news… #Nikkei #Japan #DataBreach #Phishing #Microsoft365 #CyberSecurity #DDW

🇩🇰 🚨 DENMARK CONFIRMS UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS TO CPR DATA OF ~8.8 MILLION PEOPLE  Denmark's Central Person Register (CPR) administration says unauthorized parties obtained names, addresses and CPR numbers of roughly 8.8 million registered people.  That covers living residents, people who have emigrated and deceased persons, out of about 11 million records in the system.  According to the official statement:  * Attackers misused a private Danish company's legitimate access to search the CPR system * Irregular activity took place during September and was noticed on the evening of Oct 2 * The company's access has been cut off and police are investigating * People registered with name/address protection were NOT exposed  Denmark's Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet) says the incident involved a very large number of automated lookups to identify valid CPR numbers. It received the breach notification on Oct 4.  The minister called it "a deeply serious incident" and has ordered a full security review of the CPR system. Officials say it is too early to say who is behind it.  ⚠️ Analyst Note: A CPR number plus name and address is a powerful pretexting kit. Expect phishing, phone scams and impersonation that "already know" your details. Danish authorities warn never to share passwords or codes, even with callers who seem to know your CPR number. Help: sikkerdigital.dk  Official statement: ufm.dk/aktuelt/pressemeddele… #Denmark #CPR #DataBreach #Privacy #GDPR #CyberSecurity #DDW

🤖 [GEMINI 분석] 2026-10-06 11:10 KST
🔴 위협 점수: 2026/10 (심각)

### 1. 현재 주요 사이버보안 트렌드
최근 사이버 위협은 AI를 활용해 공격 체인(Attack Chain)을 단축하고, 자동화된 취약점 보고가 급증함에 따라 Google과 같은 주요 기업이 OSS VRP(Open Source Software Vulnerability Reward Program)를 일시 중단하는 등 방어 체계에 변화가 감지되고 있습니다 ([Malwarebytes Labs](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/10/google-pauses-open-source-bug-bounty-program-after-rise-in-ai-submissions)). 또한, IoT 기기를 타겟으로 한 ClingSTUN과 같은 리눅스 백도어가 STUN 프로토콜을 악용해 통신을 은닉하고 프록시 노드로 활용하는 등 공격 기법이 더욱 정교해지고 있습니다 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/iot/clingstun-vulnerable-iot-devices-proxy-nodes)). 기업 환경에서는 Shadow IT와 관리되지 않는 자산이 여전히 주요 침해 경로로 지목되고 있으며, 생성형 AI를 악용한 피싱 및 스피어 피싱 공격이 지속적으로 고도화되는 추세입니다 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208735)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
- **TA419**: 미국 싱크탱크, 대학, 법률 기관의 AI 정책 전문가를 대상으로 신뢰 관계를 구축하여 사이버 첩보 활동을 수행 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/chinese-actor-impersonates-us-officials-cyber-espionage)).
- **ShinyHunters**: 데이터 탈취 및 갈취 혐의로 주요 조직원이 네덜란드 경찰에 체포됨 ([Krebs on Security](https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/09/dutch-police-arrest-reformed-hacker-in-shiny-hunters-investigation/)).

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
- **SK텔레콤 고객정보 유출**: 다크웹에 2,321만 건의 고객 개인정보 및 통신 이용·청구 정보가 판매된다는 게시글이 확인됨 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208736)).
- **협업 도구 피싱**: Slack의 정상적인 '워크스페이스 초대' 기능을 악용한 임원 사칭 피싱 메일이 국내 기업을 대상으로 유포 중 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5780)).

### 4. 주요 CVE / 취약점
1. **CVE-2026-90970**: GitLab AI Gateway, CVSS 9.9, 템플릿 샌드박스 탈출을 통한 RCE ([OWASPHyderabad](https://twitter.com/OWASPHyderabad/status/2107287189570695267)).
2. **CVE-2025-15226**: Sunnet WMPro, CVSS 9.8, 인증되지 않은 원격 코드 실행(웹쉘 업로드) ([DFIR_Lab](https://twitter.com/DFIR_Lab/status/2107289320465858716)).
3. **CVE-2025-15228**: WELLTEND BPMFlowWebkit, CVSS 9.8, 인증되지 않은 원격 코드 실행 ([DFIR_Lab](https://twitter.com/DFIR_Lab/status/2107289528339718190)).
4. **CVE-2026-105763**: Twenty CRM, CVSS 9.6, 평문 비밀번호 노출 ([Daily_CyberSec](https://twitter.com/Daily_CyberSec/status/2107289086398517261)).
5. **CVE-2026-61500**: Rejetto HFS, Critical, 세션 위조 및 RCE ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/rejetto-hfs-servers-now-actively-scanned-for-critical-rce-flaw/)).

### 5. IOC 요약
- **CVE**: CVE-2026-96940 ([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/microsoft-exchange-flaw-lets.html)), CVE-2026-61500 ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/rejetto-hfs-servers-now-actively-scanned-for-critical-rce-flaw/)), CVE-2026-88771/88772 ([Unit42](https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/netscaler-zero-days-exploited/)), CVE-2025-39682/53266/39964 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5781)).

### 6. 즉각 대응 권고
- **자산 식별 및 Shadow IT 제거**: 조직 내 관리되지 않는 서버 및 시스템(Shadow IT)을 전수 조사하여 노출된 DMZ 접점을 최소화할 것.
- **취약점 패치**: 언급된 NetScaler, Microsoft Exchange, Tenda 라우터 등 주요 인프라 장비의 최신 보안 업데이트를 즉시 적용할 것.
- **피싱 대응 강화**: Slack 등 협업 도구의 초대 기능을 악용한 피싱 사례가 보고되고 있으므로, 임직원 대상 보안 교육 및 비정상적인 초대 링크 클릭 주의 공지.

### 7. 위협 수준 평가
- **점수**: 8/10
- **근거**: 다수의 Critical 등급 취약점이 활발히 악용되고 있으며, 국내 대규모 개인정보 유출 사고가 발생하여 실질적인 피해 위험이 매우 높음.
